frozen_signal_replay.note: the baseline's signal stream is held fixed and only the cost parameters change. This isolates the cost channel proper: the fee and slippage delta plus the affordable-quantity change that a higher cost forces on the same signal stream. It is not a claim that a higher cost is better; a positive value here only means the extra cost mechanically bought less exposure.

double_slippage.interpretation_guard: a higher-cost scenario ending higher is a path result of different affordable quantities, not evidence that higher costs are better
